title: Discriminant of a monic quadratic
source: Theory IGCSE-14.5 Quick check 1 (b^2-4ac for x^2+4x+3 is 4); book Worked example 19 style, new numbers
stem: For the equation \(x^2+{b|int}x+{c|int}=0\), what is the value of \(b^2-4ac\)?

steps.name: A
steps.note: D is b squared minus 4c, since a is 1.

title: Larger root of a monic quadratic
source: Theory IGCSE-14.5 Quick check 2 (larger root of x^2+4x+3=0 is -1); book Worked example 19 style, new numbers
stem: The equation \(x^2+{S|int}x+{P|int}=0\) has two roots. What is the larger root?

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The roots are \({r|int}\) and \({q|int}\), so the larger root is \({q|int}\).
steps.note: q is chosen strictly larger than r. Original: roots -3 and -1.

title: Discriminant with a not equal to 1
source: Theory IGCSE-14.5 Quick check 3 (b^2-4ac for 3x^2-2x-1 is 16); book Worked example 19(c) style, new numbers
stem: For the equation \({a|int}x^2+{b|int}x+{c|int}=0\), what is the value of \(b^2-4ac\)?

steps.name: A
steps.note: Keep the signs of a, b and c when computing the discriminant.

title: Use the quadratic formula, answers to 2 decimal places

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2019), Question 6(b)(ii) only. Official answer and mark allocation from the MS PDF. The item is paper/self-mark. Parts 6(a), 6(b)(i) and 6(b)(iii) are omitted.

stem:
This question is 0580/42/O/N/19 Question 6(b)(ii), taken from the official QP.

Use the quadratic formula to solve \(4x^2+11x-300=0\).
Show all your working and give your answers correct to 2 decimal places.  [4]

steps.name: B1
steps.note: MS: B1 for 11^2-4(4)(-300) or better, as part of the B2 for a correct substitution into the formula.

steps.name: B2
steps.note: MS: B2 for the full substitution (-11 plus or minus the square root) over 2 times 4. The two B1s together make this B2.

steps.name: B3
steps.text_tex: The roots, to 2 decimal places, are \(-10.14\) and \(7.39\).
steps.note: MS: B2 for -10.14 and 7.39, B1 for each; SC1 for rounded or truncated nearby values listed in the MS.

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: Independent check: \(\sqrt{4921}=70.1498\ldots\), so \((-11+70.1498\ldots)/8=7.3937\ldots=7.39\) and \((-11-70.1498\ldots)/8=-10.1437\ldots=-10.14\), both to 2 decimal places.
steps.note: The official roots are -10.14 and 7.39. The last mark completes the official B2 for the two rounded answers.
